english.title: Aggravated burglary - other than dwelling
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having entered as a trespasser

(A)_[a building]_
(B)_[part of a building]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE BUILDING..)

(C)_[stole therein **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..) to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_
(D)_[stole therein **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..) of a value unknown]_
(E)_[attempted to steal therein]_
(F)_[inflicted grievous bodily harm upon **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) a person therein]_
(G)_[attempted to inflict grievous bodily harm upon **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) a person therein]_

and at the time of committing the said burglary had with you

(H)_[a firearm]_
(I)_[firearms]_
(J)_[an imitation firearm]_
(K)_[imitation firearms]_
(L)_[a weapon of offence]_
(M)_[weapons of offence]_

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
